`s51-source.json` contains the Season 51 records from the six JSON datasets used by the importer, retrieved from doehm/survivoR at commit `7336413e39c34c31231b9fa17281a47f731837e0` on September 27, 2026. These factual records exercise real source field names and the premiere's scoring. Tests add a clearly synthetic second episode in memory.

Source: https://github.com/doehm/survivoR (MIT license, Daniel Oehm and contributors).
